summary: Kaixin Holdings, via its wholly owned subsidiary Jet Sound Hong Kong Company Limited, entered into a securities purchase agreement on August 26, 2026 to acquire all equity of Hongkong Taohaoche Limited, a Hong Kong automobile wholesale/retail company. Consideration is 10,000,000 newly issued Class A ordinary shares held in escrow and released in three tranches tied to three two-year performance periods requiring audited revenue of RMB 1.0B, 1.1B, and 1.2B, respectively. Shortfalls trigger share cancellation; overperformance allows credits. The seller retains dividend and voting rights on escrowed shares. Escrow Agent is AUTOA2A, LTD. The target becomes an indirect wholly owned subsidiary. Watch: performance target achievement and share release mechanics.
